thread:
Mike (Sales): quick handoff — AeroMosaic signed a 12mo Dedicated + Private pilot. Pilot launch target: Apr 6. Primary asks: VPC peering (us-west-2), SSO via Okta, 10k qps burst planning, token retention 90 days, HIPAA handling required. PO expected next week. Renewal risk: they're sensitive to p50 latency >120ms and cost per token. Sales note: they will route production traffic after pilot if infra looks stable. SOW: https://redwood.company/sow/aeromosaic

Anna (CS): thanks — assigning owners. I'll run kickoff + onboarding runbook. Can sales drop contact & Okta admin email? Also need support + eng to confirm peering window.

Mike (Sales): pm me for Okta admin: sam.jensen@aeromosaic.com. Contact at infra: infra-eng@aeromosaic.com. SOW link above includes compliance addendum.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-4521 — AeroMosaic onboarding. https://redwood.company/tickets/CS-4521

Anna (CS): great. I'll create a preflight checklist in the onboarding board and schedule a 60m kickoff for next Tue. Owners tentative:
- Provisioning/VPC: Devon (Eng)
- SSO + SCIM: Tori (Support)
- Data classification & compliance: Anna
- Billing & PO: Mike

Devon (Eng): noted. For capacity planning initial suggestion: 2 x A100-dedicated to start + burst pool. We'll need expected qps by endpoint and median sequence length. Also we'll pre-provision model variant pool. Quick config snippet for ops:
```
deployment:
  region: us-west-2
  capacity_profile: dedicated
  dedicated_nodes: 2
  burst_pool: enabled
  model_variant: redwood/clean-7b-quant
  kv_cache_ttl: 300
```

Devon (Eng): two asks from eng side:
- Confirm whether customers need model pinning vs auto-fallback
- Provide traffic pattern sample (spikes / steady)

Tori (Support): for SSO/SCIM & audit: we'll need Okta SCIM creds and preferred SAML parameters. Also confirm log forwarding to Splunk/Kinesis. Default retention for audit logs is 365d — can reduce if requested. @Anna please add to runbook.

Anna (CS): putting SCIM creds request into ticket CS-4521. I'll add a task to push a minimal runbook and a failover playbook for model fallback and latency regressions. Who will own on-call for first 2 weeks? @Devon?

Devon (Eng): I can own on-call week 1, Tori can own support triage. I'll add a canary test that hits the dedicated pool simulating 2k concurrent users.

Mike (Sales): PO ETA Thurs. Also they'll want a monthly usage report for first 3 months. Can we add that to the onboarding deliverables?

Anna (CS): yes — adding 'monthly usage report x3' to tasks. I'll ask Data Ops to join first monthly report.

Tori (Support): will prepare an SSO runbook + escalations mapping. Requesting access to customer's Splunk index: index:aeromosaic-infra.

Anna (CS): next steps recap in ticket CS-4521:
- Sales upload PO + contact info (Mike) — due Thu
- CS create onboarding runbook + schedule kickoff (Anna) — due EOD Fri
- Eng to pre-provision nodes & config (Devon) — due Mon
- Support to prepare SSO runbook + logging (Tori) — due Mon

Anyone want to add anything? :eyes: 

Mike (Sales): all good — I'll join kickoff and intro customer. :thumbsup: 

Devon (Eng): adding config PR to infra repo and will link in ticket.

deploy-bot: CS-4521 updated: tasks assigned. https://redwood.company/tickets/CS-4521

Anna (CS): thanks team — I'll ping calendar invite shortly and close loop once kickoff scheduled. :white_check_mark:
